digest.component_or_area: live_jira_dc test harness (Jira DC PAT fixture)
propositions: The jira_dc_pat fixture is function-scoped with no explicit scope, so every test mints a new Personal Access Token and never deletes it, growing consumption as O(tests).
Jira Data Center caps a user at 10 PATs, so the live harness exhausts the budget and fails at SETUP with a 403 UserTokenLimitExceededException.
The failure is mis-attributed to an unrelated test module (test_transport.py) because the cause is a session-wide token budget rather than that specific test.
The fix makes jira_dc_pat session-scoped so exactly one PAT is minted per run regardless of test count, providing structural O(1) headroom.

A complementary session-start sweep should delete leftover rebar-j5-harness-* tokens from crashed runs, degrading safely (empty on cannot-enumerate, non-fatal on failed delete) and never deleting tokens without the prefix.
The failure looks flaky but is deterministic because tokens self-clear after a day via expirationDuration, so whether a run fails depends on recent instance usage.
